ui_bugs.issue: Deep-linking to /settings (and after Save->Back from settings->leaderboard history edge case) triggers 'The action "GO_BACK" was not handled by any navigator' because settings-close-button and leaderboard-back-button call router.back() unconditionally. When no history exists (deep link, PWA cold-start, in-app browser), the user is stuck on the screen. Fix: use `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/')` in both settings.tsx:48 and leaderboard.tsx:96. Reproduced: opened https://run-forever-31.preview.emergentagent.com/settings directly, saved nickname, pressed close -> toast 'The action GO_BACK was not handled...' and page did not navigate.

action_items: Fix router.back() fallback in /app/frontend/app/settings.tsx:48 and /app/frontend/app/leaderboard.tsx:96 using `if (router.canGoBack()) router.back(); else router.replace('/')`. Current code strands users when deep-linking.
Soft-delete the TEST players created during this iteration (see seed_data_creation).
Prior iteration-2 TEST_SD_T/TEST_SD_M were already soft-deleted; TEST_A1b (6ad...), TEST_B1 and the older TEST_Friend remain active in global board (pre-existing from iter 1-2).
critical_code_review_comments: audio.ts correctly implements crossfade loop: tickLoop() polls at 200ms, when cur.currentTime > duration - 2.2s it fades over 60ms*steps into the second player. loadTrack cleans up previous players via p.remove() before swapping. setTrack is idempotent (early-return when id === trackId).

settings.tsx uses useEffect(() => setNick(profile.nickname), [profile.nickname]) so when profile loads asynchronously (profile.loaded flips later), the nick state syncs. Save button disabled condition `nick.trim() === profile.nickname` prevents no-op saves. CORRECT FIX for the deep-link empty-input bug.

rca_of_issue: Deep-link back-navigation stranding: expo-router's router.back() dispatches a GO_BACK action; when the navigation stack has only one entry (direct URL load, QR scan, PWA shortcut), the root navigator rejects it and logs 'The action "GO_BACK" was not handled by any navigator'. Fix is to guard with router.canGoBack(): `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/')`. Reproduction: fresh browser context -> navigate to /settings -> press close button (settings-close-button) -> toast appears, URL stays /settings. Same code path exists in leaderboard-back-button. Not blocking core flow when navigating from main menu.
